support_report.conduct_and_legal_reports: Imibiko yokuziphatha neyomthetho ithunyelwa ukuze ibuyekizwe. Ukufayila lapha akususi lutho — ukususa okuqukethwe kulandela imithetho yomthethosisekelo (umshini we-F-SOC-003), hhayi leli fomu.
support_report.plain_words_are_fine_incl: Amazwi alula ayanele. Faka lokho obikulindele nalokho obukubonile esikhundleni salokho.
support_report.reports_land_in_the_opera: Imibiko ifika ebhokisini lokusekela lomsebenzi futhi ihlelwa ngokwemizimba. Lokhu kokwamukela akukwazi ukuhlela noma ukususa okuqukethwe uqobo.
support_report.you_need_to_be_signed_in_: Kumele ungene ukuze ufayile umbiko — ngena bese ubuyela kuleli khasi.
